text: ねえ　もう　まちくたびれて　しまったわ！

structure.jp: もう　まちくたびれて　しまったわ！
structure.en: I've gotten all worn out from waiting!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: まちくたびれて　しまった
patterns.explanation: しまう after a て-verb says the thing happened completely, often with a feeling of 'oh dear'. まちくたびれて　しまった = 'I've gone and gotten tired of waiting'.
